_comment: Generated by tools/data_gen/build_vanity_stalls.py. The `rebut` choice is gated on a flag set by an EARLIER chapter, so answering the fair requires having learned something on the way to it.

start.speaker: The Applause-Seller
start.text: You have walked a long way and no one has clapped once. Buy a little of this and they will say your name kindly.
start.text_zh: 你走了这么远的路，没有一个人为你鼓过掌。买一点这个，他们就会好好地念你的名字。

text_variants.text: You have walked a long way and no one has clapped once. Buy a little of this and they will say your name kindly.
text_variants.text_zh: 像您这样有分量的人，早该被人念着名字了。只要一点点，就够了。

text_variants.text: You have walked a long way and no one has clapped once. Buy a little of this and they will say your name kindly.
text_variants.text_zh: 你的眼太清了，不好做生意。不过——你走了这么远的路，没有一个人为你鼓过掌。买一点这个，他们就会好好地念你的名字。

choices.text: I was shown a room where the light did not come from anyone clapping.
choices.text_zh: 我看过一间屋子。那里的光，不是从掌声来的。

choices.text: Buy it. Surely one small indulgence won't cost me much.
choices.text_zh: 买下吧。区区一点放纵，想必花不了我多少。

choices.text: No. My peace is not for sale at this fair.
choices.text_zh: 不。我的平安不在这集市上出售。

answered.speaker: The Applause-Seller
answered.text_zh: 贩子的笑僵了一瞬。「……那间屋子我知道。我不进去。」

bought.speaker: The Applause-Seller
bought.text: A wise purchase! Wear it well... it suits the crowd, if not the road.
bought.text_zh: 明智之选！好好戴着……它配得上人群，纵然配不上这条路。

refused.speaker: The Applause-Seller
refused.text: Suit yourself. The narrow-eyed never could enjoy a good fair.
refused.text_zh: 随你便。眯着眼的人，从来就享受不了一场好集市。
